title: Partículas ну
reviewer: Codex R33 local semantic source review

semanticReview.method: Inspección de fuente primaria/institucional y pasaje localizado; artículo acotado al contenido respaldado; APA 7, Evidence y assessEntry posterior ejecutados.
findings: Bolden's conversation-analytic study describes ну-prefaced responses to polar and wh-questions, including responses that depart from the question's action agenda or signal an incongruent epistemic stance; the article is limited to those contexts.

Localizador: Chapter 2 abstract and section outline: pp. 25–58; lines 25–37 on publisher page. The study concerns nu-prefaced responses to polar and wh-questions and identifies non-type-conforming and epistemically incongruent responses.

APA 7: Bolden, G. B. (2018). Nu-prefaced responses in Russian conversation. In J. Heritage, & M.-L. Sorjonen (Eds.), Between Turn and Sequence: Turn-initial particles across languages (pp. 25–58). John Benjamins. https://doi.org/10.1075/slsi.31.02bol
limitations: Se retiraron afirmaciones de registro, frecuencia o uso fuera del pasaje inspeccionado.
Se conservaron los enlaces de entradas relacionadas originales.
